name: Builder CTA Card
description: Large CTA card with a brand-tinted gradient, kicker pill, logo-in-heading, two-column icon feature list, paired CTAs, and a product screenshot that fades into the card on the right.
interactions: primary button hover: invert-color overlay fades to 12%, 200ms cubic-bezier(.6,.6,0,1); active swaps to btn-bg-pressed, 50ms
light button hover: shadow lifts soft-300 -> soft-500
screenshot panel is clipped and double-faded (right 85% + bottom 65% gradients) into the card stage color
below 1024px: side panel hidden, inline screenshot below content
